Anvil v0.1.0 engine: pending voices: —

Phase S3 — mix & master: per-track FX + send rails · bus glue · master chain · auto-mix · dither

This single file was assembled from src/ by build.py — the Pattern Forge pipeline discipline: explicit part order, parser guard, sha256 identity.

Playing now: the P3 stack — VA (minBLEP + wavetable), ACID, STRING and DRUM engines, GRANULAR and SAMPLER voices, the five-module FX rack (drive · mod · delay · verb · dyn) and the 8-macro mod matrix — plus the sample core, the tap recorder, the P4 step sequencer (4 tracks · swing · p-locks · chains · scenes) and the P5 pack store (nine factory banks · 548 presets, sha-256-verified installs, offline-ready), plus the P6 Deliver card (one-press offline STEM + MIDI export — a DAW-ready zip), and the S1 studio record core (mic/line input riding the engine's own AudioContext, a count-in metronome, and lap takes that split at sequencer cycle boundaries), plus the S2 sessions layer (versioned snapshots with autosave + crash recovery, and a one-press backup zip of everything), plus the S2.1 comping layer (take lanes across the studio's takes, pick-best comping with trims and equal-power crossfades, rendered and exported as a fresh WAV), plus the S3 mix & master layer (per-track gain / pan / send rails / ducking / insert FX, a verb + delay send pair, bus glue, the master chain with LUFS / true-peak normalize targets and export dither, an auto-mix assistant, and A/B reference compare).

Levels

Both knobs ride the master tap: Instrument sets the keys bus (what the instrument plays), Master is the final out. Drag or twist the rim · wheel steps · arrow keys when focused · double-click resets.

Synth

Play it from the piano dock below or your MIDI keys.

FX Rack

The rack lands here — five modules inside the mixer worklet: drive → mod → delay → verb → dyn. All off = bit-identical bypass.

Mod Matrix

The matrix lands here — 8 macro knobs and up to 32 routing slots (env / LFO / velocity / key / rand → cutoff, reso, pitch, osc levels, pan).

MIDI

The hardware deck lands here — enable Web MIDI and your keys play Anvil through the same note path as the piano dock.

Drums

Kit pads land here — set the ENGINE select to DRUM and play the pads, the dock, or MIDI (notes below the split go to the kit).

Samples

The sample core lands here — import WAVs, see the waveform, preview through the master tap.

Recorder

Record the master output and grab a WAV.

Sequencer

The step sequencer lands here — 4 tracks, swing, probability, p-locks, chains and scenes, driving the synth through the one note bus.

Store

The pack store lands here — factory packs download once, verify sha-256 before they are stored, and stay available offline.

Deliver

The Deliver card lands here — one press renders the pattern offline (stems · master · MIDI · README) into a DAW-ready zip. Nothing plays live, nothing is uploaded.

Studio

The studio record core lands here — mic/line input riding the engine's own context, a count-in metronome, and lap takes that split at sequencer cycle boundaries. Nothing is uploaded.

Sessions

The sessions card lands here — versioned snapshots of the working state, autosave with crash recovery, and a one-press backup zip. Everything stays local.

Takes & Comping

The comp card lands here — take lanes from the studio's takes, pick-best comping with trims and equal-power crossfades, and a one-press WAV export. Nothing is uploaded.

Mix & Master

The mix desk lands here — per-track gain, pan, sends, ducking and insert FX; a verb + delay send pair; bus glue; and a master chain with LUFS / true-peak normalize targets and export dither. Render the mixdown offline, A/B it against a reference, and export the WAV. Nothing is uploaded.

Roadmap — from the plan

  • P1 — worklet voice engine + proof benchmark (measured voice count)
  • P2 — ACID · STRING · DRUM engines + sample core begins
  • P3 — FX rack, per-voice mod matrix, granular + sampler
  • P4 — sequencer / groovebox layer
  • P5 — 10 factory packs / 580 presets
  • P6–P7 — share links, cloud + community, polish, launch
